Expected closing date of the new-issue sale in the September 30, 2026 pricing release. A typed secondary price settles on the next business day, not this date.
Interest expense, net. Shown as a positive cost.
Operating income plus D&A is an illustration. Do not call it Adjusted EBITDA.
Company says 2026E Adjusted EBITDA including $6B synergies. A promise, not a fact.
Run-rate synergies the company says it will reach. Implied EBITDA without synergies is derived.
Company says about $79B net debt at close.
Historical pull. The desk does not price off this row.
About T+330 at pricing. Not a live secondary price.
No free per-bond price. Enter a clean price from FINRA.
